# ClearTextureFilters

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Textures](Blitz3D-Textures)

## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
ClearTextureFilters
```

## Description

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Removes every rule that was added with [TextureFilter](TextureFilter). Textures loaded after this call only get the flags you pass.
